Chapter III

The Wedding Journey

✦
23Nov

Baan

A traditional courtyard ceremony — marigold decorations, women singing age-old songs, and the first rituals of the celebration begin.

24Nov

Badi Banori

At the family haveli — mandana artwork, colorful fabrics, and decorative lamps set the stage for the days ahead.

25Nov

Chak Bhat & Mahila Sangeet

The liveliest night — fairy lights, Ghoomar and Kalbeliya performances, dhol beats, and family dancing until dawn.

26Nov

Royal Baraat & Wedding Ceremony

Sumeet arrives in a royal procession — elephants, decorated horses, dhol and shehnai announcing his coming.

🐘 🥁 🐎 🎺 🐘 🥁
The Varmala — garlands exchanged, and two stories become one.
Seven sacred Pheras around the holy fire.
28Nov

Reception

A royal ballroom evening — candlelight, floral décor, and classical music to close the celebration in style.
